user.title: Connect to an endpoint
user.description: Point HTTP Agent at any HTTP endpoint. After the next steps the endpoint is called once so you can pick the values you want as entities.

data_description.url: The full endpoint URL. Home Assistant templates are supported.
data_description.method: HTTP method used for every poll.
data_description.auth_type: Pick a ready-made authentication preset, or 'None' and add your own headers below.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the hostname of the URL.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the endpoint is polled, in seconds.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for a response, in seconds.
data_description.retries: How many extra attempts to make when a poll fails, with one second between attempts.
data_description.extra_headers: One header per line, written as `Name: value`. Templates are supported.
data_description.response_format: Leave on 'Auto' to detect JSON, XML, HTML or plain text from the response.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for endpoints with a self-signed certificate.

credentials.title: Authentication
credentials.description: Enter the credentials for the "{auth_type}" preset. They are stored encrypted and never shown in logs or diagnostics.

data_description.api_key_header: The header the key is sent in, for example `X-API-Key`.

body.title: Request body
body.description: {method} requests can send a body. Leave it empty if the endpoint does not need one.

data_description.payload: The request body. Home Assistant templates are supported.

select_values.title: Pick the values you want
select_values.description:
The endpoint answered with HTTP {status} and was read as **{format}**. {count} values were found.

```
{preview}
```

Pick the values that should become entities. Sensible entity types, device classes and units are guessed automatically and can be changed afterwards. You can also skip this and add entities later.

data_description.selected_values: Search the list, or type a path manually to add one that was not detected.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The endpoint rejected the stored credentials for the "{auth_type}" preset. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the URL, your network and the timeout.
error.invalid_url: Enter an absolute URL, including the http or https scheme.
error.invalid_headers: Each header must be written as `Name: value` on its own line.
error.bad_status: The endpoint answered with an error status code.
error.no_values: The response was empty or contained no readable values.

abort.already_configured: This URL and method combination is already configured.

user.title: Add a sensor
user.description: Pick a value from the latest response, or type a path yourself.

data_description.name: The entity name.
data_description.value_path: The path to read from the response.

data_description.device_class: Controls how Home Assistant formats and graphs the value.
data_description.state_class: Set to 'Measurement' or 'Total increasing' to include the sensor in long-term statistics.
data_description.icon: Overrides the icon derived from the device class.
data_description.attributes: One per line, written as `Attribute name: path`.
